fusions.name: Rolled-Up Swat
fusions.desc: Swats an enemy up to 4 tiles away with a tightly rolled sheaf, dealing 12 damage that grows the further it reaches, up to 1.4 times at full reach, and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Torn Page Flurry
fusions.desc: Tears up and flings a cone of sharp-edged pages, dealing 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Studied Pause
fusions.desc: Stops to puzzle out what you have learned: you restore 4 mana a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Practised Signs
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
